text:
olivia.engineer: Hi all — weird end to my Singapore trip. Flight rebooked to next morning due to mechanical issue, so I had to overnight at the airport hotel. I lost the taxi receipt from Changi to the hotel and I don't have the boarding pass for the original flight (airline reissued e-ticket). Questions: 1) can I still get per-diem for the extended day? 2) what do I submit for the lost taxi receipt? 3) airline sent e-ticket but no boarding pass PDF — is the airline email enough?

zev.peopleops: Short answers: 1) Yes, per-diem applies for additional overnight stays that are company-required. 2) For lost receipts, use the Lost Receipt Declaration (LRD) form and attach as "lost receipt" along with a short attestation. 3) Airline e-ticket plus rebooking confirmation is acceptable — attach the reissue email and any boarding link or PNR.

zev.peopleops: LRD requirements: employee name, date, vendor, amount (approx), reason receipt lost, manager approval line, and a signature. Finance will flag LRD entries for audit if > $75.

hannah.finance: Adding finance rules: we prefer merchant receipts. If missing, LRD up to $75 per item is accepted with manager approval. For taxi fares above $75 or airport transfers with no receipt, we need a secondary proof (card statement or driver name/platform screenshot).

hannah.finance: Policy snippet: ```Lost receipt policy:
- <$75: LRD + manager approval accepted.
- >=$75: LRD + secondary proof (bank posting, photo of vendor signage, or official invoice).
- Per-diem: apply full-day per-diem for overnight stays; proration only applies when travel begins/ends same day with total travel <24h.```

mike.manager: I can confirm Olivia's rebooked flight was company-mandated. I approve the lost taxi LRD for up to $60 and full per-diem for the additional night. Olivia, include the flight rebooking email so People Ops/Finance can confirm.

olivia.engineer: Thanks — I have the airline rebooking email (e-ticket: PNR QXZ9RT) and a photo of the taxi receipt I tore but it's smudged (total roughly SGD28). I also have a picture of the Grab driver rating screen that shows trip time and fare estimate. Will that be enough as "secondary proof" if needed?

lost-receipt-bot: LRD form template uploaded: 2267900005_lrd-template.pdf

receipts-bot: airline-reissue uploaded: 2267900120_scoot-e-ticket-qxz9rt.pdf

hannah.finance: The Grab screenshot + smudged partial receipt + LRD should be fine for that amount. Put the LRD on the same expense line, upload the airline e-ticket, and add manager approval note (Mike already approved here). We'll reimburse the taxi up to the declared amount after verifying approx match to bank posting.

olivia.engineer: One more question: I grabbed snacks and a bottled water at the airport ($14 SGD) after the delay while waiting for rebooked flight — does that count as reimbursable meal/snack, or is it under incidental cap?

zev.peopleops: Small snacks and bottled water during a company delay are reimbursable if reasonable. For airport purchases during delays, include a note "delay-related" and attach receipt. If you hit multiple snack purchases, finance may map to per-diem vs actual receipts.

hannah.finance: Practical note: if you also claim per-diem for that day, avoid double-claiming the same meals. Choose either per-diem or submit actual meal receipts for that day. If you submit receipts for specific items like the $14 snack and coffee and you're not using per-diem, we'll reimburse them.

mike.manager: Thanks everyone. Olivia: submit expense with LRD + airline e-ticket + any card statement showing the taxi/trip if you have it. I'll add an approval note in Expensify. If finance needs anything else they'll follow up.

olivia.engineer: Will do. Appreciate the quick help — uploading now and will ping when done. :thumbsup:
